こんにちは。はじめまして。500円募集を始めてみたとのツイートを拝見し、リクエストを送ってみることにしました。

スプラトゥーン3のイカちゃんを希望しています。画像サイズ、表情、構図など全ておまかせでお好きなように描いていただければと思います😊

資料はURLにて失礼いたします。
ご検討よろしくお願いいたします🙏

https://x.com/spla_illust_/status/2021812133722567064?s=46&t=ucCuhOmwbyMNBKXdsApjpw

Hello,

I think your art is wonderful and the atmosphere in your illustrations is so refreshing.

If possible, I would like to request an illustration of streamer/vtuber ながやまめめ (X: @meme_nagayama). She is a someone who sings very often and has an absolutely wonderful, refreshing voice. She also plays the guitar incredibly well!

This is the best image I have of her (I hope it is acceptable): 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gRZ4_qq4WP9oiv0BoWACSOZbI_18nDs0/view?usp=sharing

This is by her Live 2D modeller and may also be useful: https://x.com/uki_ism/status/1977539786400559127

I have been wanting to make this request for a long time now and that's when I came across this illustration from you:
https://skeb.jp/@CTH_art/works/43

I thought this was so beautiful and it made me want to request an art from you. I love the "far away" perspective and how the foreground and the character and the background fir together so nicely!

In terms of the theme of my illustration request, I would like it to be about ながやまめめ and the song Henceforth by Orangestar. Link to the song:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L13gCEZJVRU

The song and the thumbnail illustration of Henceforth also gives me that refreshing feeling that I saw in your art and in ながやまめめさん's voice. I am happy for you to to use your artistic freedom and interpret my request how you would like. You can change the outfit if you think smething else would be more suitable for the illustration. My only requests are that the art is not sexualised and the illustration is a landscape-orineted illustration and it have that .

Overall, I think I would like the theme of this illustration to be "Summery" and "Refreshing".

If possible, I would also like your permission for this illustration to be used for ながやまめめさん's streaming activities inclusing for stream thumbnails and stream background and for posting on social media platforms like X.

Thank you for your time.
I would be very happy if you could consider my request.

（アイコン、Xを含むSNSへの投稿、YouTubeサムネ等）に
